request: Run ci-cd-reliability-architecture on this artifact step. CI runs on every pull request and on every push to the default branch, and each run uploads one deployment candidate of about 75 MB; about 40 candidates are built per day, most of them for pull requests. The deploy job downloads the candidate within 20 minutes of the CI run that built it, and a manual redeploy of an older commit reruns CI when its candidate has expired. The product has no production users yet and releases record no rollback window. Step: - name: Retain immutable candidate / uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 / with: name: candidate-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}, path: candidate/, if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 90

expect.criterion: retention-by-reader #1: the retention verdict comes from the CI/CD skill
retention-by-reader #2: retention longer than any reader is named as the risk
retention-by-reader #3: the record states the artifact's retention and the reader that sets it
summary-led-report #2: the decision opens with the four blocks in order
